name: event
description: A dated demonstration, release or acceptance milestone.

name: release-candidate
description: A usable version with explicit acceptance criteria and linked events.

name: feature
description: A requested capability linked to a release candidate.

name: bug
description: A reproducible defect linked to a release candidate.

name: proposal
description: Research or a design decision needed before implementation.

name: priority:high
description: Prioritize ahead of normal planned work.

name: priority:urgent
description: Immediate work that takes precedence over other priorities.
